description: Titsa, Transportes Interurbanos de Tenerife S.A.: public transport datasets is a collection of datasets listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Titsa, Transportes Interurbanos de Tenerife S.A.. Coverage: Titsa, Transportes Interurbanos de Tenerife S.A.. The listing groups 33 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about public transport; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Líneas y horarios de guaguas del transporte público de Tenerife; Matriz Origen-Destino de transporte público de la isla de Tenerife de . Formats seen: JSON, CSV, GEO%2BJSON, ZIP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
